problems.quote: Reserve Bank of India — established under this act
problems.problem: The Reserve Bank of India was established by the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, not by the Government of India Act 1935.
problems.correction: Reserve Bank of India — established by RBI Act, 1934
problems.verifierReason: RBI established by RBI Act 1934, not Government of India Act 1935.

problems.quote: Dyarchy at Centre — introduced in limited form (only partially implemented)
problems.problem: Dyarchy at the centre was provided for in the Government of India Act 1935 but never implemented because the federation never came into existence.
problems.correction: Dyarchy at Centre — introduced but never implemented
problems.verifierReason: Dyarchy at centre never implemented as federation never came into force.

problems.problem: The Pearson correlation coefficient r ranges from -1 to +1, not from 1 to +1.
problems.verifierReason: Original omitted negative bound; correction accurately states -1 to +1.

problems.problem: The Tetrahymena group I intron and the RNase P RNA component alone have k_cat ~0.1 min⁻¹; 10 min⁻¹ is characteristic of the RNase P holoenzyme (with protein).
problems.verifierReason: Tetrahymena group I intron and RNase P RNA alone have k_cat ~0.1 min⁻¹; 10 min⁻¹ applies to RNase P holoenzyme.

problems.problem: Misspelling of the meiotic prophase I stage 'pachytene' as 'pachyze'.
problems.verifierReason: Original misspells 'pachytene'; correction restores correct spelling.

problems.problem: Cephalopods (Octopus, Sepia, Loligo) have a closed circulatory system, not open

problems.quote: paternal uniparental disomy (UPD) or imprinting defects silencing the paternal allele at 15q11‑q13 cause Prader‑Willi syndrome
problems.problem: Paternal UPD (both chromosomes from father) causes Angelman syndrome, not Prader‑Willi. Prader‑Willi is caused by maternal UPD or paternal deletion/imprinting defect silencing the paternal allele.
problems.correction: maternal uniparental disomy (UPD) or imprinting defects silencing the paternal allele at 15q11‑q13 cause Prader‑Willi syndrome
problems.verifierReason: Paternal UPD causes Angelman syndrome; maternal UPD causes Prader-Willi. Correction fixes UPD parent-of-origin.

problems.quote: maternal UPD or imprinting defects silencing the maternal allele at the same region cause Angelman syndrome
problems.problem: Maternal UPD (both chromosomes from mother) does not cause Angelman syndrome; it causes Prader‑Willi. Angelman syndrome is caused by paternal UPD or imprinting defects silencing the maternal allele.
problems.correction: paternal UPD or imprinting defects silencing the maternal allele at the same region cause Angelman syndrome
problems.verifierReason: Maternal UPD causes Prader-Willi; paternal UPD causes Angelman. Correction fixes UPD parent-of-origin.

problems.problem: Hagfish are scavengers, not ectoparasites; only lampreys are ectoparasitic.
problems.verifierReason: Original incorrectly labels hagfish as ectoparasitic; correction fixes by stating lampreys are ectoparasitic and hagfish are scavengers.
